sentences.text: During discussion, it is found that in terms of the settlement half of the property has to be given to Rajshreeben.
However, possession thereof is required to be given which, as per the statement of Ritaben, is with Mr.Gireeshbhai (brother-in-law of Ritaben).

Prior to passing of an order of closure of the criminal case accepting the settlement, it would be appropriate to direct that possession of the property to which the settlement has been arrived at and signed by the parties be delivered to the complainant.

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that two weeks time may be granted to hand over the possession and a bailiff may be appointed through court who make take recourse in this regard.

3. Having considered the submissions, we direct the jurisdictional court where the criminal case is pending to appoint one bailiff to take possession of the property as specified in the settlement agreement and a report be made available within two weeks.
4. In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioners.
As report of the bailiff was not received, order was passed on 06.10.2025 asking for the report by issuing reminder.

However, despite two orders of this Court, bailiffs report was not received and this Court passed order dated 27.10.2025, which is reproduced as under:
1) In furtherance to order dated 08.09.2025, bailiffs report was not made available to this Court.
However, time was granted on 06.10.2025 to produce the report, as per the reminder sent by the Registry.
Despite two orders of this Court, bailiffs report is not made available by the concerned Court through District Judge.
2) Let notice be issued to the Registrar General of the High Court of Gujarat as to why the Judges appointed in the Trial Court have not sent the reports despite two orders of this Court.
3) Information be sent by e-mail to the Registrar General asking the report within a week.
4) In case, the report is not made available, this Court shall be constrained to pass order seeking presence of the Judge of the Jurisdictional Court and the District Judge.
5) List on 07th November, 2025.

6) In any case, as per report, the settlement dated 23.06.2025 has been executed between the parties and now the parties have settled their disputes out of Court by way of settlement.

7) Learned counsel appearing on behalf of both the parties conceded that they shall abide by the terms of the settlement dated 23.06.2025 and in lieu thereof, all the disputes inter se may be treated as resolved and impugned order may be set aside in terms of the said settlement quashing FIR No. 11207028210655 of 2021.

8) In view of the above and the settlement arrived at between the parties, the impugned order is set aside and FIR No. 11207028210655 of 2021 dated 31.08.2021 at PS Halol town Panchmahal and all proceedings emanating therefrom stand quashed.
9) Accordingly, the criminal appeal stands disposed of.
